mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.category_id, p.name, p.short_description, p.description, p.sku, p.barcode, p.brand, p.price, p.subscription_price, p.stock_quantity, p.weight_gram, p.is_active, p.is_featured, p.created_at, p.updated_at, IFNULL(rs.average_rating, 0) AS average_rating, IFNULL(rs.review_count, 0) AS review_count FROM favorites f INNER JOIN products p ON p.id = f.product_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT product_id, ROUND(AVG(rating), 1) AS average_rating, COUNT(*) AS review_count FROM reviews WHERE is_active = 1 GROUP BY product_id ) rs ON rs.product_id = p.id WHERE f.user_id = #{user_id} AND p.is_active = 1 ORDER BY f.created_at DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO favorites ( user_id, product_id, created_at ) VALUES ( #{user_id}, #{product_id}, NOW() )
